snippet.title: Meet the Robinsons (video game) - FULL GAME walkthrough | Longplay
snippet.description:
Meet the Robinsons is an action adventure video game developed by Avalanche Software and published by Disney Interactive Studios in 2007 and it's based on the animated movie with the same name. Wilbur Robinson uses his father's time travel machine without his permission to do some adventuring in the past. After returning to the present his machine was stolen and it was used to change the timeline destroying almost everything he knew. Wilbur must now seach the entire city for his machine go back in time to reverse the changes.
